chat.rematchOpen: A rematch is open: press Rematch to keep chatting there.

again.keeps: A rematch keeps the trainers, the format and any teams you brought.
again.startsFour: The computer keeps its seats; it starts when every trainer presses it.
again.startsTwo: It starts when you both press it.

lobby.quickNote: Random-battle sets from Gen {gen}, checked against these rules.
lobby.bring: each of you brings a team, checked against Pokémon Showdown's rules.
lobby.runOutDefault: Run out on a turn and a default move is made; run out of time altogether and you lose.
lobby.runOutPick: Run out and the timer picks a move for you; a second time in a row loses.
lobby.timerOffAny: Off: take your time. Any of you can start it mid-battle.
lobby.timerOffEither: Off: take your time. Either of you can start it mid-battle.
lobby.public: Listed in Watch live: anyone can watch.
lobby.private: Private: only people with the link can watch.
lobby.fairFour: You see only your own team and what the others reveal. Leaving forfeits after {secs} s away.
lobby.fairFourMulti: You see only your own team and what the others reveal. Leaving forfeits after {secs} s away (your team loses, as on Showdown).
lobby.fairFourFfa: You see only your own team and what the others reveal. Leaving forfeits after {secs} s away (you're out; the others battle on).
lobby.fairTwo: You see only your own team and what your opponent reveals. Leaving forfeits after {secs} s away.
lobby.unrankedMulti: Unranked: Showdown doesn't ladder Multi Battles either, so these never move your rating.
lobby.unrankedFfa: Unranked: Showdown doesn't ladder Free-For-Alls either, so these never move your rating.
lobby.teamFirst: Pick or paste a team first.
lobby.title: Pokémon battle
lobby.invite: {host} challenges you to a {format} battle. Pick a trainer name to join.
lobby.inviteTeam: {host} challenges you to a {format} battle. Pick a trainer name and a team to join.
lobby.about: Send the link to a friend. The battle starts when you're both ready.
lobby.shareHost: {host} challenges you to a {format} battle on PokéIQ!
lobby.shareMe: I challenge you to a {format} battle on PokéIQ!

visitor.two: This battle is between two other trainers.
visitor.four: This battle is between four other trainers.

replay.instantTitle: Watch the battle so far from the start (Showdown's instant replay)
replay.downloadTitle: Showdown's replay file: opens in any browser and plays in Showdown's replay player
